comment: mondata.c Resists_Elem() 183-184: a debug Samurai with no cold resistance starts two-weapon combat (X), wishes for ice under himself and steps off it. domove() calls slippery_ice_fumbling() (hack.c 2743), which asks resists_cold(&youmonst); the hero lacks the intrinsic, so the item loop adds W_SWAPWEP to the slot mask for the two-weaponing hero.
